title: Marketplace box: UI draft chat and session gift chat are two copies reset by hand
trigger: Open Buy-by-name for chat A, load a gift, close; open for chat B
effect: No bug today: open_marketplace_for clears the name/comment inputs and sets session.payments.marketplace_gift = None by hand in step with MarketplaceBox::open_for; a missed path would show A's quote in B's box
fix: One owner: put the draft chat, inputs reset and the GiftPurchase in one value replaced whole on open (GiftPurchase carries the privacy/error too)

title: Sticker category fetch is re-sent from render after a failed send; the Fetch never reaches Failed
trigger: Open the sticker tab while the TDLib sender is gone (send_json returns Err); sticker_category_strip sees sticker_categories.is_idle() every frame
effect: fetch_sticker_categories -> sticker_request fails, take()s the request and calls lists.for_purpose(GetStickerCategories), which is None, so sticker_categories stays Idle and is never marked Failed; every render defers another failing send and the category strip never shows or reports an error
fix: On a failed send call sticker_categories.failed(..) (add GetStickerCategories to the failing-send path), and have the strip only ask when the Fetch is Idle and never re-ask from Failed
